questions.promptEn:
다음 중 우리말을 영작한 것으로 적절하지 않은 것은?
① 그들은 그녀가 테니스 동아리에 가입하는 것을 허락했다.
→ They let her join the tennis club.
② 그는 그의 팀이 매일 연습하게 했다.
→ He made his team practice every day.
③ 그가 당신에게 내일 전화하도록 하겠습니다.
→ I will have him call you tomorrow.
④ 그녀는 자신의 아들에게 매일 아침 개를 산책시키도록 했다.
→ She got her son to walk the dog every morning.
⑤ 그녀는 그에게 먹기 전에 손을 씻도록 했다.
→ She had him to wash his hands before eating.
choices: They let her join the tennis club.
He made his team practice every day.
I will have him call you tomorrow.
She got her son to walk the dog every morning.
She had him to wash his hands before eating.
